patch_list: Makes the in-game Cheats screen reachable by redirecting the Settings -> Credits button to SystemScreen.OpenCheats. Single-player UI only; it does not grant items, currency, or purchases.
Mocks PlayFab Catalog API for IAP fulfillment without platform billing.

Makes all in-game store purchases free by bypassing the PlayFab server and Play Store UI. Patches IAPService.PurchaseBundle to return immediately without calling IStoreController.InitiatePurchase, and patches StoreService.PurchaseItem for…
Bypasses PlayFab validation and grants items locally, setting price to free.
Read-only diagnostics for libil2cpp.so: hashes the library and checks whether the KoPP2 2.21.4 PurchaseItem and IAP grant-function offsets are reachable in both ABIs.

Replaces the harmless CheatsScreen.ShowCheatAlert method with an immediate return in both libil2cpp.so ABIs. Demonstrates static ELF RVA mapping and byte patching; it does not touch billing, purchases, entitlements, or networking.

Hooks every probed purchase and PlayFab method in libil2cpp.so and logs "CALLED: <method>" through NGUIDebug's on-screen overlay. Diagnostic only; it does not change any return value, response, entitlement, or purchase result.

Adds a touch-through, auto-scrolling log panel over the lower 30% of the screen, with padding from the screen edges. It shows this process's logcat output (Unity Debug.Log, native and Java logs). Diagnostic only; no game state is changed.
